Name: HW's Tiny Farmhouse
Author: heathinwillows
Description:
to celebrate the 10th year anniversary of this beloved game I've come to a conclusion to make a sexy farmhouse for my sexy farm maps because i'm skinny:3

requirements:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url] - this fixes the initial furniture and the crib position in the farmhouse 

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url] - not required but recommended if your furniture is relocated at an inaccessible place

as of now, the only available renovation is the removal and addition of crib as to not defeat the purpose of living in a small farmhouse.

i MIGHT add a tiny sunroom as an additional renovation in the near future, but my current schedule isn't favoring me enough to work on my mods much as it's our preliminary exams week.
